# FQHEDiskCorrelation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnDisk` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnDisk/FQHEDiskCorrelation`

```text
FQHEDiskCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHEDiskCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (default value = 0)
    -l, --momentum : single particle momentum (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 0)
    --force-maxmomentum : force the maximum single particle momentum to a particular value (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (default value = 0)
    --boson : use boson statistics
    --fermion : use fermion statistics
    --state : name of the vector file describing the state whose correlation has to be plotted
    --input-states : use a file to describe the state as a linear combination
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    --coefficients-only : only compute the one body coefficients that are requested to evaluate the correlation profile
    --correlation-profil : only compute the correlation profil along x
    --force-xsymmetry : assume the wave function is invariant under the x <->-x symmetry
    --force-ysymmetry : assume the wave function is invariant under the y <->-y symmetry
    --huge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)

plot options:
    --output : output file name (default output name replace the .vec extension of the input file with .rhorho.dat)
    --nbr-samples : number of samples in radial direction (value must be greater than 10, default value = 1000)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)
    --use-precomputed : use precomputed matrix elements to do the plot

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
